sourceFile: 18. BRS-2015 Report test Suspension 201506 -A and B  new vender WorldTop  Hanoi Vina_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Comparable test-vs-normal evidence exists, but the draft misstates the changed factor and omits major outcome groups.
issues: Changed factor is filename-like, not the material/vendor lot change.
Baseline and test conditions are explicit but left unspecified.
Only tension is modeled; NG, welding, function, and decision outcomes are omitted.
Subgroups such as date, line, SP A/B, test type, and lot are not preserved.
Some cited Sheet1 rows are not shown in context, limiting verification of those values.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to new vendor WorldTop Hanoi Vina suspension 201506 A/B lot test vs Normal.
Use change domain material/supplier, not generic process condition.
Add outcomes for assembly/frame NG, spot welding NG, function NG, tension, and module-line checks if citeable.
Preserve subgroup keys for date, E2-4B line, lot/test round, SP A/B, and tension type.
Cite header, purpose, paired test/normal rows, and decision rows for each outcome.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations are citeable but insufficiently complete for final evidence.
